violations.rule: A fault inside the flat: no explanation of the rule (no_rule_lecture); the refusal states the general rule of when a fault is the tenant's instead of only saying this one is theirs
violations.quote: כיור בתוך הדירה הוא באחריות הדייר, אז על זה לא נפתחת אצלנו קריאה.

X.notes: Hebrew reply to English with צהריים טובים and the name once, a kind word, no ticket, no tradesman, an offer to help and a warm goodbye with no question; the one fault is that the refusal is put as the rule itself.
